description: Major rail safety-related occurrences on running line (derailments and collisions) is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. This dataset contains historical information about the number of major rail safety running line occurrences (derailments, collisions) on Queensland's rail network. This data represents legacy information from 2009 to 2016, when the Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) was the Rail Regulator in Queensland. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are incident, rail, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
